q: Which team won the 1986 NBA championship?
answer:
The Boston Celtics won the 1986 NBA Championship, defeating the Houston Rockets in the NBA Finals.

q: When was the three-point line introduced in the NBA?
answer:
The NBA introduced the three-point line ahead of the 1979–80 season.

* The line was adopted from the American Basketball Association (ABA), which had featured the three-point shot throughout its history.
* When first implemented in the NBA, it was set at a uniform distance in the corners and a longer distance at the top of the arc.
* Chris Ford of the Boston Celtics scored the first three-pointer in NBA history during October 1979 against the Houston Rockets.
* The league briefly shortened the line during the 1990s before returning it to the original dimensions.

q: Who holds the record for most points in a single NBA game?
answer:
Wilt Chamberlain holds the record for most points in a single NBA game.

* Chamberlain achieved the historic feat playing for the Philadelphia Warriors against the New York Knicks.
* Kobe Bryant holds the second-highest scoring game in NBA history against the Toronto Raptors.
* Chamberlain also holds the third spot on the single-game scoring list against the Los Angeles Lakers.
